headline: Sequence and structure models of RNA paired with measured readouts of function
label: Rna Sequence Structure Inference
summary: Recent preprints and publications pair sequence- and structure-based RNA predictions with massively parallel and in-cell experimental readouts.
synthesis: The dominant thread is inference of RNA behavior from sequence and structure, with predictions anchored to or evaluated against experimental data. A preprint interpretable hybrid framework combining handcrafted descriptors with RNA-FM embeddings in a stacked ensemble predicts LLPS-associated RNAs (AUC-ROC 0.935). AbRiDGed, an ab initio method, predicts self-cleaving ribozymes across species, identifying around 150 novel classes. On the experimental side, a published DMS-based study quantifies RBP occupancy on RNA hairpins and links it to decay in human cells, while a massively parallel synthetic 3'UTR reporter screen of about 2M inserts maps short regulatory elements. What is new is the pairing of computational prediction with measured readouts, although the items address distinct molecular processes rather than a single mechanism.
